title: A radial integral of a nondecreasing profile charges every radius iff the profile does
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ and f : ℝ → [0, ∞] be nondecreasing (Monotone f). Then [for every ε > 0, ∫_{ℝ^d} f(√(ε² − ‖σ‖²)) dL^d(σ) ≠ 0] if and only if [for every ε > 0, f(ε) ≠ 0], where √ = Real.sqrt and L^d is Lebesgue measure on ℝ^d = Euclid d.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), Monotone f → ((∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → (∫⁻ σ : Euclid d, f (Real.sqrt (ε ^ 2 - ‖σ‖ ^ 2))) ≠ 0) ↔ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → f ε ≠ 0)
